label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
world_settlement_slot: city.orc_camp (PROPOSAL; no world slot bound yet, unlike dwarf_hold which is registered)
concept: War camp occupying and reinforcing a ruined city. Theme: salvage/scar economy, 'repairs remain visibly scarred'. Civic + recruit structure IDs are seeded by settlement_blueprints.json (orc.warchief_hall / orc.salvage_forge / orc.spoils_market / orc.war_drum_tower / orc.patched_walls + 7 recruit structures).

verified_from_current_snapshot: orc_hammer_warrior is a wired battle roster unit (SoulCampaignBattleBridge.cpp:9,12,16-21; SoulRealtimeBattleArena.cpp:2140,2358).
settlement_blueprints.json enumerates the full Orc structure set used as the design seed.

Regions orc_camp, orc_watch, orc_war_camp, orc_badlands, orc_ruined_field, orc_broken_bridge, north_pass exist in all six-faction region lists (e.g. Data/CampaignComposition/SixFactionRuntimeProof.json).
verified_owned_asset_metadata: Medieval Ruins (fab_41faeeed3014466d9861374190d4f438) = CONFIRMED_OWNED, HIGH confidence, Local evidence TRUE + imported association TRUE, Copperlight Fit A, type=environment, era realm/crownfall (Copperlight ai_index/products/fab-41faeeed3014466d9861374190d4f438-medieval-ruins.md). This is the strongest-grounded of the three new faction donors.

Ravenhold ruined wall families (CurtainWall_10m / CurtainWall_10m_Ruined, Lrg_Wall_10m / Lrg_Wall_10m_Ruined) referenced in Data/environment_asset_bindings.json 'ravenhold' as siege-damage donor; appropriate for orc.patched_walls scar grammar.
local_runtime_asset_check_required: No orc settlement environment is in Data/SettlementEnvironments/EnvironmentRegistry.json (no visit/battle environment, no DevelopmentProof). Orc hold is entirely greenfield vs the Dwarf proof.
YI_BanditCamp tents/weapon racks and Coastal Ruins terrain (support donors in settlement_blueprints.json) ownership not yet confirmed in Copperlight (CHECK).
Only orc_hammer_warrior is a wired unit; all other orc dwellings' units are roster proposals.

resources_model.proposed_secondary: salvage (future; thematic 'spoils' resource from orc.spoils_market; no current producer; save-safe additive key only)

buildings.effect_summary: Settlement control + hero services root (analogue of human.keep / dwarf.kings_hall). Pre-built seed.

Siege defense. Theme: repairs stay visibly scarred (use Damaged/Ruined mesh branches of ASoulSettlementBuildingActor rather than clean Intact). Lower base integrity than stone-faction walls. Level 2 (significant) is a timber-reinforcement upgrade.
buildings.manifestation_ref: Ravenhold ruined walls + timber repair grammar

buildings.effect_summary: Resource exchange (analogue of human.market). Level 2 income branch mirrors the +100 gold/day human.market L2 effect in SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem::AdvanceDay. Orc flavour: income scales with recent conquest (DESIGN; current snapshot has no conquest-income hook).
buildings.manifestation_ref: tent/market composition (YI_BanditCamp support donor; CHECK ownership)

buildings.effect_summary: Equipment/upgrades (analogue of human.forge). Cheaper + faster than dwarf.great_forge; lower quality ceiling (DESIGN differentiation).

Core fighter dwelling. Orc identity is cheap/fast mass: 1-day normal build (vs dwarf stoneguard 2-day significant) and higher weekly growth. Gates orc_hammer_warrior via RequiredBuildingId. Level 2 adds growth.
Shield/heavy fighter dwelling (parallels human shield guard concept).
Aggressive shock unit dwelling. Also a settlement morale/offense buff source (DESIGN: war-drum synergy). settlement_blueprints marks confidence UE_REQUIRED.
Defense/morale (settlement_blueprints civic). Garrison morale buff + watch range. No new unit. Pure effect building (tests the 'effect-only building' path, like a non-service non-recruit node).

Magic/support dwelling. Orc signature school proposal = Lightning/Blood (DESIGN; forbidden-school table in HeartlandDevelopment.json lists Lightning as human-forbidden, so it is a clean cross-faction differentiator). Binds an orc hero/support spell via RequiredBuilding, parallel to the human arcane chain.
Heavy brute dwelling capstone. Deep chain (berserker_pit -> shield_pit -> grunt_barracks) + forge requirement.
Apex beast dwelling (COMPOSITE). Apex availability is a hard LOCAL CHECK (no orc apex mesh confirmed).

recruitment_binding.unit_status: LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK REQUIRED (apex pipeline unverified)

dag_validation.note: No cycles; every prerequisite id present; satisfies ValidateDefinition.

faction_identity_vs_human: Orc = cheap, fast, scarred. Core military nodes are NORMAL (1 day) where Human/Dwarf equivalents are SIGNIFICANT (2 days), trading build quality/integrity for tempo. Walls start at lower integrity and visibly scar on repair. This is a genuine mechanical differentiation, not a rename.
